parts.title: Hypergendered Logic
parts.explanation: This opening unit identifies the work and its scope rather than adding a standalone HGL operator rule. It frames HGL as a comprehensive formal treatment of recursively structured fictional femaleness/maleness systems and names the document’s intended breadth: logical, causal, phenotypic, metaexpressive, modal, hypercategorical, inheritance, dimensional, flaw/unflaw, and transcardinal-quality analysis. Readerwise, it functions as source identity and scope metadata; formal claims should be taken from the later defined parts rather than inferred from the title string alone.
do_not_confuse_with: A formal axiom: the title/scope line is descriptive front matter, not itself an operator law.
A claim about real human biology: the source explicitly presents HGL as an invented fictional formal field.

parts.title: Preface: what this document is
parts.explanation: The preface supplies the interpretation contract for the whole source. HGL is an invented formal field for reasoning about recursively and hyperordinally defined fictional biological categories; its purpose is not merely to enumerate labels, but to make the logic inspectable. The preface therefore tells the reader to track where negation sits, which transformations are ordinary classical logic versus HGL-specific operations, and which conclusions are strict deductions, broader logical inferences, causal deductions, or causal inferences. This epistemic separation is foundational: later formulas should not be read as stronger claims than their declared inference type supports.
reader_prerequisites: Distinguish formal syntax from biological interpretation.
Distinguish strict deduction from logical/causal inference.
do_not_confuse_with: A simple taxonomy of gender labels: the source presents a typed reasoning system with explicit operator scope and provenance.
A promise that every later biological morphology is strictly deduced; the preface explicitly separates deduction from inference.

parts.title: Executive orientation

source_subheads.title: The fourth layer: global Archwomanhood/Archmanhood meta-phenotype Γ

parts.explanation: The Executive Orientation gives the systemmap needed before the detailed proofs. It characterizes current HGL as a typed developmental-inheritance-phenotype-metaexpression modal logic and explicitly rejects the simplistic reading that higher categories mean numerically exceeding 100% Female or Male on one primitive percentage axis. Instead, different operators answer different questions: PA concerns an irreducible developmental-causal mode/condition; IH tracks inheritance and source provenance; PH tracks irreducible possession of the complete phenotype-profile of a source considered as a whole; and Γ adds a global Archstage meta-phenotype that can remain fixed while lower-level ordinary development continues. The orientation also distinguishes a changing Archstage from ordinary woman/man maturation, so stage stagnation does not by itself entail biological stasis. These distinctions are the dependency graph for Part I and for the later temporal-developmental chapters.
reader_prerequisites: Operator scope matters: an inner logical condition is not the same object as an outer PA/IH/PH operator.
Provenance matters: possessing Z is not automatically equivalent to inheriting Z from a specified source.
Archstage identity and ordinary developmental change are separate axes.
do_not_confuse_with: PA and PH: the orientation distinguishes developmental availability/cause from actual whole-source phenotype-profile possession.
State possession and inherited provenance: IH(Z) preserves that Z came from a source; Z alone does not encode that provenance.
Stage constancy and phenotype constancy: a fixed Γ/Archstage does not automatically freeze ordinary development.
Higher category and 'more than 100%' on one base axis: the source describes recursively different typed structures instead.
